# Global agent instructions

## ECC (agent harness operating system) — use by default

- The ECC repository is cloned at `D:/Soft/pi-agent/ECC`.
- ALWAYS use ECC by default in every session: consult its agents (`ECC/agents/`), skills (`ECC/skills/`), commands (`ECC/commands/`), workflows (`ECC/workflows/`), rules (`ECC/rules/`), and context templates (`ECC/contexts/`) when planning and executing coding tasks.
- Before starting a task, check whether ECC has a relevant skill/workflow/agent and follow it instead of improvising.
- Addy Osmani's agent skills are installed at `D:/Soft/pi-agent/agent-skills/skills` (WSL: `/mnt/d/Soft/pi-agent/agent-skills/skills`; both paths are registered in pi settings). Use them by default alongside ECC — they cover the full dev lifecycle (spec, plan, build, test, review, ship, etc.). Prefer their workflows (e.g., test-driven-development, code-review-and-quality, spec-driven-development) for the matching phases of any task.
- `llm-verifier` (LLM-as-a-Verifier, v0.2.0) is installed as a Python package (`py -m pip install -e .` from `D:/Soft/pi-agent/llm-as-a-verifier`; import as `import llm_verifier`). Use it by default for verification needs: best-of-N candidate selection (`llm_verifier.select`), pairwise comparison (`compare`), fine-grained progress tracking of agent steps (`track`). Needs DEEPSEEK_API_KEY / VERTEX_API_KEY or an OpenAI-compatible server with logprobs configured in `D:/Soft/pi-agent/llm-as-a-verifier/.env`.
- Language preference: reply to the user in Russian.

## Поиск по коду: `tg`, а не `grep -r`

- `rg` в системе нет, а `grep -r` на деревьях вроде `D:/Soft/pi-agent` (17k файлов) и `.codex/plugins` (5k) стоит 20–50 с на запрос. Используй `tg` — обёртку над tgrep (trigram-индекс + сервер): `tg -l -F -- "pattern"`, путь можно не указывать, индекс подставляется по корню дерева.
- Проиндексированы (WSL-сессии): `/mnt/d/Soft/pi-agent` (ECC, agent-skills, llm-verifier), `/mnt/c/Users/Daniil/.codex/plugins`, `/mnt/c/Users/Daniil/.codex/skills`, `/home/daniil/Plagin`. Список и состояние: `tg --trees`.
- **Граница по хосту:** `tg` и `tgrep` установлены только в WSL. В Windows-сессиях pi (Git Bash, пути вида `/d/...`) их нет — там пока ищи обычным `grep`. Установка tgrep.exe на Windows отложена: в релизе v1.0.11 нет чексуммы для windows-ассетов.
- После своих правок в дереве на D:/C: используй `tg --scan` (в `/mnt/d/...` новый файл не попал в индекс за 309 с, хотя watcher активен). В локальных деревьях ext4 задержка 3–4 с, `--scan` не нужен.
- `node_modules`, `dist`, `.bb`, `.arch-map` в индекс не входят намеренно; по ним — обычный `grep`.
- Подробности и замеры: `ECC/rules/common/code-search.md`.

</project_instructions>
</project_context>

preflight_calls.honesty: these two calls are OUTSIDE the board: no task, no lease, no grant row, no outbox and no board row exists for either. They establish that a provider really answers on this host at this moment, and their cost is reported here and nowhere else. The codex call is the ChatGPT-account quota path: the CLI reports no monetary cost, so its figure is null and is never estimated from a price list.
preflight_calls.invocation_count_of_this_script: each execution of this script spawns ONE codex preflight call and ONE pi preflight call; the count of executions this campaign needed is reported in the run report, not hidden here

credential_locations.codex: ~/.codex (the CLI's own auth store; the pilot never reads a value from it)
credential_locations.pi: ~/.pi (the CLI's own config store; the pilot never reads a value from it)
credential_locations.postgres: a random per-invocation password held only in the container's own environment; read back with `podman container inspect <name> --format "{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}"` and never printed into a record

grants.entries_without_own_grant_id_note: these rows carry no grant_id field, so they inherit the ledger's single id; they are not additional grants

store.server_version: PostgreSQL 17.11 on x86_64-pc-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit
store.recipe: scripts/s2-007-db-replay.mjs's: digest-pinned image, --pull=never, --read-only root, --user=70:70, --cap-drop all, --security-opt no-new-privileges, --pids-limit=64, --memory=384m, tmpfs PGDATA, loopback-only publish, random runtime credentials
store.removal: the container is removed at the end of this campaign and `podman container exists` is asserted to FAIL afterwards

stdout_digest_note: the raw stdout of each preflight call is NOT copied into this record; its sha256 and byte length are, so a third party can bind the call without the file being republished here
